prompt: Use case: product-mockup / stylized-concept. Asset: ONE high-end photoreal 3D industrial-design FM radio receiver cutout for the MUVS artist website's existing 3D gallery. Primary request: a NEW extremely stylish minimalist contemporary radio, Apple-like material discipline and immaculate proportions, NOT a copy of a branded device. Genuine transparent-alpha background. One isolated object only. No floor, no pedestal, no environment, no baked cast ground shadow, no people/hands, no accessories, no watermark, no manufacturer logo. Subject: compact horizontal rounded-rectangular portable FM radio. Opaque warm-neutral MATTE WHITE micro-textured polymer shell, beautifully precise soft-radius corners. One large BLACK / deep-charcoal circular finely perforated speaker grille occupying the left part of the front. Quiet dark graphite-gray recessed control panel on the right with a small clean horizontal dark tuning display and a SINGLE beautifully machined brushed-aluminium tuning knob; thin vivid acid-lime #ccff00 ring/detail around that knob. Two or three small dark-gray tactile buttons only. A narrow restrained lime detail in the dial/display and one tiny lime power indicator; lime is an accent, not broad fluorescent illumination. Elegant low-profile white carrying handle with a slim brushed-metal inner insert, thin brushed-aluminium telescopic antenna angled gently upper-left; unmistakably a radio, not a Bluetooth speaker or computer. Subtle dark graphite seam at base, tiny dark rubber feet aligned on one flat plane. Excellent coherent physical construction, real materials, soft ambient self-occlusion in recesses, satin metal highlights. No exposed circuits or clear-glass case, no retro clutter, no decorative text, no stickers, no excessive knobs. Composition: square image, complete object and complete antenna visible, front face dominant with a slight view of right side and top, camera only slightly above center of body, natural 50mm product view. Compact non-elongated proportions, body fills about 76 percent image width with comfortable transparent safety margins, antenna neither clipped nor excessively tall. Lighting: soft neutral studio key from upper-left, balanced moderate contrast, readable gray-edged white silhouette designed for a pale-gray-to-white website background, no blown highlights or heavy black underside. Premium minimal 2026 object, sculptural yet functional. Deliver clean antialiased edges and real transparent empty pixels everywhere outside the object, no white/black rectangle and no rendered checkerboard.
